stem.text: Why do people with HIV/AIDS have a higher occurrence of malaria than people without HIV/AIDS?

A.text: HIV/AIDS and malaria are both diseases where the pathogen travels in blood.

B.text: HIV/AIDS and malaria are both transmitted in blood.

C.text: HIV/AIDS infects T-lymphocytes which are used by the malaria pathogen.

D.text: HIV/AIDS suppresses the immune response to the malaria pathogen.
